input.quote: Each party is responsible for the supervision, direction, and control of its respective personnel. IBM reserves the right to determine the assignment of its personnel. IBM may subcontract portions of
input.rationale: Preferred position is met: the agreement imposes no non-solicitation, no-hire or inducement restriction on Bluefly. § 14.8 Personnel covers only supervision/direction of each party's own personnel, IBM's right to assign personnel and its right to subcontract; § 14.16 Freedom of Action states only that "Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others." Full-text searches for "solicit", "hire", "employ", "induce", "recruit" and "personnel" return no hiring or poaching restriction. The deterministic sub-checks for a 12-month duration cap and a general-solicitation carve-out fail only because there is no non-solicit clause to measure; that absence is the customer-favourable outcome, so no redline or counterparty comment is warranted. Reviewer note: the Base Terms incorporate Order Forms and attachments (Attachment A: Facilities Services, the Service Option Attachments) that are not part of the reviewed text; those documents should be checked for any hiring restriction, and if one appears we would negotiate to the fallback (mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, 12 months from the end of involvement, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no no-hire).
